'''Satrank''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Anointed People]] from the planet [[Abonshee|Masterhome]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a [[Godling]], a member of the [[Species/Legends|species's]] [[Noble/Legends|nobility]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Anointed People]], Satrank was part of the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] caste known as [[Godling]]s who ruled over the [[Anointed People]] of [[Abonshee]] under the leadership of the [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was visited by [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In an attempt to test the Alliance's honesty and commitment to diplomacy, Satrank was assigned by Trisstan to feign being an ambitious conspirator vying for the throne and approach the Rebels in an attempt to help overthrow the Godking. Satrank was to report their answer directly to Trisstan during the welcoming gala held out the [[Godking's castle|royal castle]].<ref name="Godking" />
